notes: I replaced the linear guess with an odd, saturating Hill-type curve `y = -A·sign(x)·t/(1+t)` where `t=(|x|/s)^p`, fitted to E2's monotone-decreasing ratio y/x (steep near 0, saturating toward ~-69 at large |x|). This matches E1's large-|x| values (~-60 to -72) and E2's full curve within a few percent.
